<reason>Side A built the cleaner live route: targeted harm enforcement is allowed immediately, but criminalizing sheltering itself requires a usable alternative to distinguish inability from refusal. Side B never answered where lawful compliance ends if every location is penalized with no bed offered, and its net-safety claim stayed at cleared-park benefit without outweighing transferred hazards, lost belongings, and broken outreach. A's staff-assessment plus immediate-action answers blunted the veto/delay charge.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's moving-on-is-not-a-destination / endless-series pressure, answered by B only with successive no-parking zones, left B biting the bullet of punishment everywhere with nowhere lawful to go.</best_rebuttal>
